Completion evidence for [non-codebase] ACs after merged Gerrit CL 2668 (patchset 2, GitHub Actions run 33955668061, Verified+1; LLM-Review+1; unresolved comments 0):

- Five-spelling scan run after migration with grep: `grep -R -l -e "bridge-status" -e "bridge-fsck" -e "bridge-probe" -e "jira-onboard" -e "verify-authorship" tests --exclude-dir=__pycache__`. Remaining matches were classified as explicit invalid-choice tests / migration guard tests only: `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_heldout.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_vocabulary_e2e_heldout.py`, `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_dispatch.py`, `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py`, `tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py`, `tests/unit/test_identity_ac7_bff8_heldout.py`, and `tests/unit/test_jira_onboard.py`.
- Focused CLI/registry tests passed locally, including `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py`, `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_dispatch.py`, and `tests/unit/test_jira_onboard.py`.
- Focused bridge/verify interface tests and regenerated-output tests passed locally; final targeted run covered the changed CLI/bridge/verify/reference/DC-wiki surfaces with 238 passing tests, after an earlier 363-test targeted pass.
- Documentation generation checks passed locally: `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check`, and `python scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py --check`.
- Local `make lint` passed with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
- Local `make typecheck` passed with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
- Sandboxed mutation check: temporarily restoring the `verify-authorship` route made `test_removed_simple_compatibility_aliases_are_parse_time_invalid_choices` fail, then restoring the removal made it pass again.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Five approved pre-1.0 compatibility commands still invoke their canonical owners. `bridge-status` is the sole hidden alias. The visible aliases are `bridge-fsck`, `bridge-probe`, `jira-onboard`, and `verify-authorship`. Their replacements are `bridge status`, `bridge fsck`, `bridge check-access`, `bridge setup`, and `verify-identity`. `reconcile` plus `reconcile-check` are excluded because their dependency-ordered migration is separate.

## Implementation Plan

1. Remove `bridge-status` from `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:534-543`, `bridge-fsck` from `:544-551`, and `bridge-probe` from its `bridge-probe` registry entry beginning at `:610` (anchor by command name if line numbers drift). Remove `verify-authorship` factory/handler entries at `:432/:460` and `jira-onboard` factory/handler entries at `:438/:466` (anchor by command name if line numbers drift). Do not touch `_reconcile`.
2. Retire alias-only parser, factory, and help wiring. Each old spelling must produce argparse's standard invalid-choice error at parse time with exit code 2. It must not invoke a handler. Each canonical spelling keeps its current owner plus exit behavior.
3. Regenerate outputs with `scripts/gen_cli_help.py`, `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`, `scripts/build_cloud_adf_corpus.py`, and `scripts/build_dc_wiki_corpus.py`.
4. Run the exact five-spelling string scan in the final acceptance criterion. Classify each match. Replace alias-success tests with invalid-choice tests. Retarget behavior-preserving invocations to canonical commands. Remove retired names from route census collections. Regenerate fixture matches.
5. Replace removed commands in maintained operational prose. Preserve historical ADR plus release-note references as history.

## File Impact

- `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py`, advanced bridge/Jira/verify parser factories, alias help routing — registrations plus alias-only parser wiring; delete the now-orphaned bridge-fsck/bridge-probe parser arms while retaining the shared Jira setup parser for canonical `bridge setup`
- `scripts/gen_cli_help.py`, `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`, `scripts/build_cloud_adf_corpus.py`, `scripts/build_dc_wiki_corpus.py` plus generated help/reference/ADF/wiki outputs
- `src/rebar/_commands/fsck_scan.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/fsck_authorship.py` — source-emitted operational remediation text must say `verify-identity` instead of the removed `verify-authorship` command
- `docs/cli-reference.md`, maintained CLI/identity/operational docs, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md` — current versus historical command language
- `tests/fixtures/cloud_adf_corpus/bodies_01.json`, `bodies_02.json`, `tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py` — regenerated fixture plus reference contracts
- `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py`, `test_cli_help_writing_guidelines_jerboa.py`, `test_help_overview_coverage.py`, `test_schema_coverage.py` — generated/documentation contracts
- `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_heldout.py`, `test_bridge_vocabulary.py`, `test_bridge_vocabulary_e2e_heldout.py`, `test_bridge_vocabulary_heldout.py`, `test_intercept_registry_cutover_s6_heldout.py` — bridge behavior
- `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py`, `test_cli_registry_dispatch.py` — remove retired names from route/individual-arm census assertions
- `tests/unit/test_jira_onboard.py`, `test_identity_ac7_bff8_heldout.py` — replace direct alias-success tests with parse-rejection tests
- `tests/unit/test_identity_ts3_117b.py`, `test_identity_ts3_117b_heldout.py`, `test_identity_3183.py`, `test_identity_3183_heldout.py`, `test_reclaim_collapse.py`, `test_enrich_drain.py` — retarget live `verify-authorship` subprocess calls to `verify-identity`
- `tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py` — migrate any current command fixture to the canonical spelling
- `tests/unit/test_bug_review_tier.py` — classify or retarget the synthetic `bridge-status` fixture match surfaced by the five-spelling scan so it is not an unclassified current-command reference

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The registry contains no `bridge-status` entry.
- [x] The registry contains no `bridge-fsck` entry.
- [x] The registry contains no `bridge-probe` entry.
- [x] The registry contains no `jira-onboard` entry.
- [x] The registry contains no `verify-authorship` entry.
- [x] `bridge-status` is treated as the sole hidden alias in migration history.
- [x] The other four spellings are treated as visible aliases in migration history.
- [x] Each removed spelling produces argparse invalid-choice exit code 2.
- [x] No removed spelling reaches its handler.
- [x] `bridge status` preserves current owner plus exit behavior.
- [x] `bridge fsck` preserves current owner plus exit behavior.
- [x] `bridge check-access` preserves current owner plus exit behavior.
- [x] `bridge setup` preserves current owner plus exit behavior.
- [x] `verify-identity` preserves current owner plus exit behavior.
- [x] Regenerated CLI help omits each removed command.
- [x] Regenerated CLI reference omits each removed command.
- [x] Regenerated Cloud ADF corpus omits each removed command.
- [x] Regenerated Data Center wiki corpus omits each removed command.
- [x] Each listed route-census test removes retired names.
- [x] Each listed alias-success test becomes an invalid-choice test.
- [x] Each listed subprocess invocation uses a canonical command.
- [x] [non-codebase] `rg -l -e "bridge-status" -e "bridge-fsck" -e "bridge-probe" -e "jira-onboard" -e "verify-authorship" tests` is run after the migration.

- [x] Every remaining scan match is one of: an explicit invalid-choice test; a regenerated fixture; or historical migration evidence.
- [x] Maintained operational prose uses canonical commands.
- [x] Historical ADR plus release references retain old spellings only as historical evidence.

- [x] [non-codebase] Focused CLI tests pass.

- [x] [non-codebase] Lint passes.
